structuralEvidence: Shadow archive is keyed/persisted by scan_date rows and can be delete-and-rewritten on same-date rerun.
External evidence collection consumes the current scan.shadowArchive rows, then external evidence persistence also deletes same scan_date and upserts by (scan_date,symbol).
Outcome reader joins external evidence to Shadow by scanDate|symbol.
The shared key proves only current-row alignment; it does not prove both records belong to the same immutable first-known scan generation or decision-state receipt.
A same-date rerun/retry can therefore replace both sides without preserving which evidence was available to the original decision generation.
counterEvidence: Using scanDate|symbol avoids obvious cross-date/cross-symbol joins.
Provider capturedAt/sourceDate fields improve source timing observability.
These protections do not solve generation identity or mutable same-date replacement.
requiredContract: immutable scanGenerationId / decisionReceiptId on Shadow population receipt
external evidence child rows reference the exact parent generation/decision receipt
reruns append a new generation instead of replacing prior evidence
reader selects an explicit as-known generation and reports orphan/mismatch counts
no promotion-grade join when parent generation is UNKNOWN
inferenceRule: scanDate|symbol-only joins remain DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY for PIT promotion claims until generation lineage is certified.
optimizationBridge: No Formal optimization candidate; evidence provenance repair only.
